questions.text:
Think of two people doing the same kind of work in your place. What Do you personally think is important in deciding 
Looking at the things below, please write '1' in the box next to the thing that you think is most important at your place of work. Then write '2' next to the thing that you think is next most important, and '3' next to the thing that you think is third most important. Leave the other boxes blank. 
At my work, deciding on two people doing the same kind of work, how important is... 
B. How well the employee does the job
